assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.text: Welcome to this week's book review.
In the studio with me is Dr.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.zh: 演播室里和我在一起的是李凯文博士，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.text: Professor of Anthropology and author of the best -selling book,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.zh: 人类学教授，也是畅销书《

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.text: Changing Traditions in the Modern World.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.zh: 现代世界中的传统变迁》的作者。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.text: could you tell us what anthropologists study and what your own area of interest is?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_45e5c3cb6e35e48.zh: 首先，您能告诉我们人类学家研究什么，以及您自己的兴趣领域吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.text: Anthropology in a general sense is the study of humanity.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.zh: 从广义上说，人类学研究的是人类。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.text: I know that's not very exact.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.zh: 我知道这说得不太准确。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.text: That's why we have many types of anthropology like linguistic anthropology and social anthropology.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.zh: 因此，人类学有许多分支，例如语言人类学和社会人类学。
我的专业是文化人类学。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.text: I study different cultures around the world and how social and political changes affect these cultures.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b491d20eda5c97e.zh: 我研究世界各地不同的文化，以及社会和政治变化如何影响这些文化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.text: And when did you first become interested in anthropology?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.zh: 您最初是何时对人类学产生兴趣的？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.text: I grew up in a multicultural home.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.zh: 我在一个多元文化家庭中长大。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.text: My mother is American and my father is Korean.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.zh: 我母亲是美国人，父亲是韩国人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.text: They were both English teachers, so we traveled a lot.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.zh: 父母都是英语教师，所以我们经常旅行。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.text: As a child, I lived in Japan,
That's why I decided to study anthropology.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_31649214d580f4f.zh: 这就是我决定学习人类学的原因。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.text: Growing up in different cultures helps you realize that customs and traditions are often local.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.zh: 在不同文化中成长，会帮助你认识到习俗和传统往往具有地方性。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.text: Things that are acceptable in one culture can be completely unacceptable in another.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.zh: 一种文化中可以接受的事物，在另一种文化中可能完全不能接受。
不过，尽管文化之间存在一些差异，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.text: I have noticed that there are often more similarities than differences between people.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.zh: 我发现人与人之间的相似之处往往多于不同之处。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.text: Customs and traditions change all the time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.zh: 习俗和传统一直在变化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.text: Some traditions die out because our way of life changes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6ab1ebacb28b1fd.zh: 有些传统会随着生活方式改变而消失，
但大多数传统会适应变化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.text: As I understand it, that's one of the main points of your latest book.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.zh: 据我了解，这正是您新书的主要观点之一。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.text: my book is about the effect of modern technology on traditions around the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.zh: 我的书讲的是现代技术对世界各地传统的影响。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.text: It's well known that things such as electricity,
the telephone and television have changed our lives significantly.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.zh: 电话和电视等事物极大改变了我们的生活。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.text: The introduction of these inventions into our lives has changed many of our customs.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e10f21d1a09c774.zh: 这些发明进入我们的生活，改变了我们的许多习俗。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.text: families spent time playing board games or listening to the radio in the evening.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.zh: 家庭晚上会一起玩桌游或听收音机。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.text: These activities would deepen family relationships.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.zh: 这些活动会加深家庭关系。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.text: people spend more time interacting with other people over the internet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.zh: 人们花更多时间通过互联网与他人互动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.text: There are people who complain about the changes that technology has brought to our lives.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.zh: 有些人抱怨科技给我们的生活带来的变化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.text: Personally, I think these changes are fine.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.zh: 就我个人而言，我认为这些变化没有问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.text: We still spend time interacting with other people, but it's not always face -to -face.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_85f3fb6c6edce48.zh: 我们仍会与他人互动，只是不总是面对面。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.text: In your book, you discuss how technology has changed the way we celebrate important holidays.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.zh: 在您的书中，您讨论了技术如何改变我们庆祝重要节日的方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.text: A simple example is sending cards or messages.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.zh: 一个简单的例子是寄卡片或发送信息。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.text: people sent each other cards to celebrate important events like an anniversary or a new baby.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.zh: 人们会互寄卡片，庆祝纪念日或新生儿等重要事件。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.text: more people send messages through social networking sites or by text or email.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3284458e0a1b7bc.zh: 更多人通过社交网站、短信或电子邮件发送祝福。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.text: Another example of changing customs is holiday food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.zh: 习俗变化的另一个例子是节日食物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.text: people spent a lot of time and effort preparing special meals for celebrations.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.zh: 人们会花大量时间和精力准备庆祝用的特别餐食。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.text: It was usually the women who did this.
Some dishes could take up to a week to prepare.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.zh: 有些菜肴准备起来最长要一周。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.text: But now, we don't have to work so hard.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.zh: 但现在，我们不必那么辛苦了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.text: This is because we have modern kitchens and supermarket food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.zh: 这是因为我们有现代化厨房和超市食品。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.text: We don't have to spend endless hours making our own butter or bread anymore.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.zh: 我们再也不必花无数小时自己制作黄油或面包。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.text: Everything is quicker and easier now.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8a24336188fd3a2.zh: 现在一切都更快、更容易了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.text: I remember my grandmother working for days to make food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.zh: 我记得祖母会花好几天准备食物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.text: She had a huge cookery book, which she got from her grandmother.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.zh: 她有一本很厚的烹饪书，是从她祖母那里得到的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.text: Everything had to be exactly as it was when she was a little girl.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.zh: 一切都必须和她小时候完全一样。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.text: That's a good example of a tradition which has been replaced by technology.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.zh: 这是一个被技术取代的传统的好例子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.text: You can find any recipe you want on the internet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.zh: 你可以在网上找到任何想要的食谱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.text: This means that many people don't need cookery books anymore.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4d48cc29b92a42f.zh: 这意味着许多人不再需要烹饪书了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3a9e7832936e49f.text: Another thing is that many families now go out instead of cooking at home.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3a9e7832936e49f.zh: 另一点是，现在许多家庭选择外出就餐，而不是在家做饭。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3a9e7832936e49f.text: families hire catering companies to provide food for weddings or special occasions.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3a9e7832936e49f.zh: 例如在印度，家庭会聘请餐饮公司为婚礼或特殊场合提供食物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3a9e7832936e49f.text: In the United States, at Thanksgiving,
which is one of the biggest celebrations, many families go to restaurants because they don't want to spend their holiday working in the kitchen.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3a9e7832936e49f.zh: 感恩节是最重要的节日之一，许多家庭会去餐馆，因为他们不想在厨房忙着度过假日。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7cbf904b14d6b67.text: So people do continue their tradition of eating a special meal.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7cbf904b14d6b67.zh: 因此，人们仍延续吃特别餐食的传统。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7cbf904b14d6b67.text: They just do it in a different way.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7cbf904b14d6b67.zh: 他们只是换了一种方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7cbf904b14d6b67.text: But customs and traditions do change and adapt to the modern world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7cbf904b14d6b67.zh: 但风俗和传统确实会改变，并适应现代世界。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: So our assignment is to discuss customs which have been changing recently.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 所以我们的任务是讨论近来发生变化的风俗。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: You know, how modern lifestyles have changed people's behaviour.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 你知道的，就是现代生活方式如何改变人们的行为。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: holidays are one kind of custom.
Can you think of any holidays which have changed?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 你能想到有哪些已经发生变化的节日吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: It reminds me that Mother's Day is in two days and I haven't bought a gift for my mum yet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 这提醒我，母亲节两天后就到了，而我还没给妈妈买礼物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: Who has time for shopping when we have so much work to do?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 我们有这么多工作要做，哪有时间购物？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: I get tired of shopping for gifts.
I actually don't know why we have to get gifts for every little holiday.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 我确实不知道为什么每个小节日都必须送礼物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: Wouldn't our mothers be just as happy if we just spent time with them?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 如果我们只是花时间陪母亲，她们难道不会一样开心吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: You know, made it a special event, like taking them out to lunch at a nice restaurant.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 比如把它办成特别的活动，带她们去一家不错的餐厅吃午饭。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.text: How did this whole gift -giving for every holiday tradition get started anyway?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8f47402b96cdba5.zh: 这种每逢节日都要送礼的传统到底是怎么开始的？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: How holidays have become too commercial.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 节日如何变得过度商业化。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: I think that it shows that you were thinking of someone.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 我认为这表明你一直在想着某个人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: Because you went out and got someone some chocolate or jewellery or a scarf or something at the last minute.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 因为你在最后一刻出去给某人买了巧克力、珠宝、围巾之类的东西。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: Everyone knows that people usually buy gifts because it's an obligation,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 大家都知道，人们通常因为义务而买礼物，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: not because they really want to.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 不是因为他们真的想买。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: Well, you have to spend time thinking about the gift and get something thoughtful, you know,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 你得花时间想想礼物，选一件贴心的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: Like maybe the new book by their favourite author.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 比如他们最喜欢的作家写的新书。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: But I'm not convinced because then you have to spend money.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 但我并不信服，因为那样就得花钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: Money which could be spent on more important things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 这笔钱本可以花在更重要的事情上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.text: all that time you spent shopping you could have instead spent with the person you're shopping for.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_def7dc89bd7b7fd.zh: 而且，你花在买礼物上的时间，本可以陪伴你要送礼的人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: I couldn't agree more.
And it's not just holidays which are a problem.
Personally, I think we give too many gifts for other special occasions too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 我个人认为，在其他特殊场合我们也送了太多礼物。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: Like when my sister graduated from university last year,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 比如去年我妹妹大学毕业时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: she got lots of gifts and money too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 她收到了很多礼物和钱。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: The focus was all on opening gifts.
I've heard that when people receive more than a few gifts,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 我听说当人们收到不止几件礼物时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: they usually can't even remember who gave them which gift.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 他们通常甚至记不清哪件礼物是谁送的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: Instead,
why not write letters of advice for the future?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 不如写几封给未来的建议信？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: That would be more special.
That's a great idea!
Sorry,
I don't agree.
I doubt that graduates will be happy if we change that custom.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 我怀疑如果我们改变这个习俗，毕业生会开心。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: I think that graduation gifts are practical.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 我认为毕业礼物很实用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: Don't young people need some gifts and money for starting their new life?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 年轻人开始新生活时，难道不需要一些礼物和钱吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: And they can always look at the gift and think of the person who gave it to them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.zh: 他们也总能看到礼物，并想起送礼的人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_32ab2a22a2ea1aa.text: I think it's a nice custom.
I'm still really not convinced.
I mean...
